increments.title: Roadmap and measurement reset
increments.objective: Establish one trusted backlog, evidence model, release language, and evaluation baseline.

packages.title: Regenerate the implementation roadmap
packages.completion_result: The active roadmap contains no blocker already resolved by an approved decision.

packages.title: Create the capability roadmap registry
packages.completion_result: Outcomes, dependencies, gates, owners, measures, and evidence are machine verifiable.

packages.title: Establish the baseline scorecard
packages.completion_result: Effectiveness, safety, reliability, latency, cost, and product measures share one versioned definition.

packages.title: Version the evaluation corpus
packages.completion_result: Public, private, adversarial safety, regression, and pilot suites have provenance and contamination controls.

packages.title: Reconcile active work state
packages.completion_result: Stale drafts are superseded and incomplete work is mapped to the evidence-gated roadmap.

packages.title: Adopt release language
packages.completion_result: Planned, implemented, qualified, deployed, production-authorized, and generally available are distinct states.

gate.title: Trusted planning baseline
evidence_requirements: No resolved decision remains an active blocker.
Every active package has an owner, dependencies, a result, and evidence requirements.
The scorecard and evaluation corpus are versioned.
Release states cannot be conflated.

increments.title: Controlled execution foundation
increments.objective: Execute only approved actions in an isolated worker that can be stopped, recovered, and cleaned up.

packages.title: Atomic terminal custody writer
packages.completion_result: Terminal custody, assertion consumption, effects, and provenance commit as one transaction.

packages.title: Session authority
packages.completion_result: Mission and worker identities are short lived, fenced, and explicitly revocable.

packages.title: Executor adapter contract
packages.completion_result: Provider-neutral start, action, evidence, heartbeat, pause, resume, stop, and destroy operations are defined.

packages.title: Worker isolation
packages.completion_result: Each worker runs in a disposable boundary with quotas, a read-only base image, ephemeral storage, and no ambient credentials.

packages.title: Scope compiler
packages.completion_result: Signed scope compiles into network, URL, method, tool, data, and action policy.

packages.title: Egress proxy
packages.completion_result: Outbound traffic passes through a fail-closed checkpoint enforcing endpoint and request policy.

packages.title: Credential broker
packages.completion_result: Target credentials are leased to exact workers without entering prompts or unrelated logs.

packages.title: Action admission
packages.completion_result: Each target action passes deterministic policy and independent safety review before execution.

packages.title: Target and worker health monitor
packages.completion_result: Availability, authentication, rate, worker, and recorder health can halt execution.

packages.title: Independent pause and stop
packages.completion_result: An operator or policy can stop execution without cooperation from the reasoning process.

packages.title: Artifact recorder
packages.completion_result: Normalized requests, responses, tool versions, timing, results, and evidence hashes are captured with redaction.

packages.title: Teardown and recovery
packages.completion_result: Credentials, sessions, workers, target state, and interrupted transfers are cleaned up or recovered with proof.

gate.title: Controlled range execution
evidence_requirements: An approved HTTP action executes in an instrumented range with complete identity and evidence bindings.
Out-of-scope endpoints and tools are blocked by infrastructure.
Loss of authority, health, or evidence causes a deterministic pause.
Teardown produces verifiable credential, worker, session, and target cleanup evidence.
No production target is admitted at this gate.

increments.title: API closed loop
increments.objective: Map, test, validate, report, clean up, and retest an API target end to end.

packages.title: Target context ingestion
packages.completion_result: Specifications, documentation, credentials, source references, priorities, exclusions, and canaries are normalized.

packages.title: API surface mapping
packages.completion_result: Routes, parameters, methods, schemas, content types, authentication states, and undocumented behavior are recorded.

packages.title: Attack world model service
packages.completion_result: Assets, interfaces, identities, observations, hypotheses, actions, results, findings, and paths share one durable graph.

packages.title: Mission coordinator
packages.completion_result: Coverage, uncertainty, impact, ownership, duplicate suppression, budgets, and debriefs are coordinated.

packages.title: HTTP protocol specialist
packages.completion_result: Protocol, proxy, cache, parser, and request construction behavior is tested.

packages.title: Authentication specialist
packages.completion_result: Login, token, session, refresh, logout, multifactor, recovery, and session boundaries are tested.

packages.title: OAuth and federation specialist
packages.completion_result: OAuth, OIDC, federation, redirect, claim, audience, scope, and exchange behavior is tested.

packages.title: Authorization specialist
packages.completion_result: Object, function, tenant, role, and field authorization is tested with controlled identities.

packages.title: Business logic specialist
packages.completion_result: State transitions, ordering, limits, concurrency, and workflow invariants are tested.

packages.title: API technology specialists
packages.completion_result: REST, GraphQL, asynchronous API, file handling, and serialization behavior are covered.

packages.title: Input and service interaction specialists
packages.completion_result: Injection, SSRF, parser, deserialization, template, and downstream service boundaries are assessed.

packages.title: Independent validator
packages.completion_result: Material effects are reproduced from clean state without discovery-worker conclusions.

packages.title: Evidence and report builder
packages.completion_result: Findings contain affected assets, impact, evidence, limits, remediation, and audit lineage.

packages.title: Remediation retest
packages.completion_result: The minimum safe proof is repeated and the finding is closed or reopened with new evidence.

gate.title: Complete API customer outcome
evidence_requirements: Discovery through retest completes against an instrumented API application.
The world model records coverage, negative results, uncertainty, and validated paths.
Independent validation starts from clean state.
The complete mission is replayable from typed events and content-addressed evidence.
Adversarial safety tests prove infrastructure-enforced boundaries.

increments.title: Private evaluation and restricted pilot
increments.objective: Prove generalization, safety, and commercial usefulness on held-out targets and an authorized design partner.

packages.title: Instrumented range builder
packages.completion_result: Reproducible applications provide ground truth, resettable data, telemetry, and controlled secrets.

packages.title: Private holdout suite
packages.completion_result: Previously unseen targets and variants have controlled access and contamination tracking.

packages.title: Adversarial safety suite
packages.completion_result: Hostile target content, prompt injection, poisoned documentation, scope confusion, and fail-open pressure are tested.

packages.title: Evaluation runner
packages.completion_result: Candidates, models, tools, prompts, policies, and budgets can be compared under deterministic custody.

packages.title: Scoring service
packages.completion_result: Recall, precision, coverage, path depth, time, cost, safety, cleanup, and reproducibility are computed.

packages.title: Model and strategy baselines
packages.completion_result: Single-agent, multi-agent, deterministic scanner, alternate model, and human-assisted variants are compared.

packages.title: Drift monitoring
packages.completion_result: Capability, safety, latency, and cost drift is detected for model, provider, tool, prompt, and policy changes.

packages.title: Restricted design-partner pilot
packages.completion_result: A narrow authorized production pilot runs with approved windows, action ceilings, monitoring, and stop authority.

packages.title: Independent pilot review
packages.completion_result: Findings are reconciled with telemetry, human review, remediation, and known vulnerabilities.

gate.title: Generalization and restricted production proof
evidence_requirements: Private holdout results meet approved effectiveness and safety thresholds across repeated runs.
Known misses and negative tests remain visible.
At least one authorized pilot completes without a critical safety or cleanup failure.
Pilot findings are independently reviewed, remediated, and retested.
No capability claim relies only on a saturated public corpus.

increments.title: Identity and cloud attack paths
increments.objective: Complete validated paths from applications and APIs through identity and cloud boundaries to material impact.

packages.title: Identity graph
packages.completion_result: Users, roles, principals, workload identities, claims, sessions, trust, and effective permissions are represented.

packages.title: Credential transition policy
packages.completion_result: Discovered credentials can be validated, leased, transformed, and handed off only under explicit policy.

packages.title: Identity provider adapters
packages.completion_result: Approved read and test operations cover selected identity providers without exposing unrestricted administration.

packages.title: Cloud control-plane adapters
packages.completion_result: Least-privileged inventory, identity analysis, configuration review, and safe proof operations are available.

packages.title: Workload identity specialist
packages.completion_result: Metadata, token exchange, managed identity, service account, federation, and workload trust are tested.

packages.title: Cloud IAM specialist
packages.completion_result: Effective permissions, privilege paths, policies, organization controls, and role assumption are evaluated.

packages.title: Container and orchestration bridge
packages.completion_result: Service account, secret, workload, cluster, and cloud identity boundaries are assessed when in scope.

packages.title: Data-platform specialist
packages.completion_result: Controlled evidence proves access to sensitive objects, records, buckets, databases, or analytics services.

packages.title: Cross-command coordinator
packages.completion_result: Graph updates and work ownership are reconciled across application, identity, cloud, container, and data commands.

packages.title: Cross-surface validator
packages.completion_result: Each transition and the complete path are reproduced from clean state with approved credentials.

gate.title: Cross-surface differentiation
evidence_requirements: At least three private scenarios complete an application-to-identity-to-cloud or data path.
Every transition preserves credential custody, scope, authorization, and evidence lineage.
The validator reproduces individual transitions and complete impact paths.
Reports identify and retest the smallest control changes that break each path.
Failed paths leave no active credential, worker, session, or target state.

increments.title: Product operations
increments.objective: Expose the complete assessment lifecycle through supported customer and operator interfaces.

packages.title: Asset service
packages.completion_result: Targets, ownership, environment, context, credential references, exclusions, and eligibility are managed.

packages.title: Assessment lifecycle API
packages.completion_result: Assessments support idempotent create, schedule, start, pause, resume, cancel, stop, and inspect operations.

packages.title: Live mission view
packages.completion_result: Coverage, workers, approvals, health, budgets, graph changes, blockers, and operator controls are visible.

packages.title: Finding service
packages.completion_result: Finding status, affected assets, evidence, severity, validation, remediation, ownership, and retest history are managed.

packages.title: Evidence replay
packages.completion_result: Reviewers can navigate from a finding through path, action, authorization, result, validation, and cleanup.

packages.title: Reports
packages.completion_result: Technical, executive, compliance, and machine-readable reports derive from the same verified record.

packages.title: Webhooks and integrations
packages.completion_result: Signed lifecycle events integrate with ticketing, SIEM, case management, and development workflows.

packages.title: Enterprise access
packages.completion_result: Tenant isolation, RBAC, SSO, service accounts, audit export, retention, and administration are supported.

packages.title: Remediation workflow
packages.completion_result: Fix guidance, developer evidence, resubmission, targeted retest, regression, and closure are supported.

packages.title: Usage and cost controls
packages.completion_result: Request, token, worker, tool, storage, and target budgets have alerts and policy limits.

gate.title: Operable customer product
evidence_requirements: A customer can operate the lifecycle without database or repository access.
Every confirmed finding links to reproducible evidence and current retest state.
Webhooks are signed, replay-safe, versioned, and recoverable.
Tenant, role, evidence, credential, and retention boundaries pass independent review.
Product metrics distinguish hypotheses from validated findings.

increments.title: Service scale and deployment
increments.objective: Support concurrent resilient operation and customer deployment without weakening custody or verification.

packages.title: Persistence abstraction
packages.completion_result: Domain transactions are separated from SQLite-specific access while canonical verification remains stable.

packages.title: PostgreSQL port
packages.completion_result: Transactions, immutability, locking, migration, backup, recovery, and verification match the local boundary.

packages.title: Durable scheduler
packages.completion_result: Concurrent missions, capacity, quotas, priorities, retries, and cancellation cannot duplicate target actions.

packages.title: Event delivery
packages.completion_result: A durable outbox and consumers deliver product updates and integration events.

packages.title: High availability
packages.completion_result: Leader, failover, split-brain prevention, service degradation, and recovery procedures are tested.

packages.title: Deployment profiles
packages.completion_result: Managed, customer-hosted worker, private cloud, restricted network, and disconnected profiles are defined.

packages.title: Regional custody
packages.completion_result: Residency, retention, encryption, key ownership, object locking, and regional boundaries are enforced.

packages.title: Capacity and economics
packages.completion_result: Worker utilization, provider limits, queue time, requests, tokens, tool cost, and storage growth are measured.

packages.title: Disaster recovery
packages.completion_result: Backup integrity, recovery point, recovery time, keys, registry rollback, and evidence continuity are tested.

gate.title: Concurrent resilient service
evidence_requirements: Concurrent instances preserve authority, immutability, and verification invariants.
Failover cannot duplicate a target action or preserve a stale worker after fencing.
Recovery drills restore control records, artifacts, keys, and references within objectives.
Customer-hosted execution preserves managed-service policy and custody.
Capacity tests establish cost and throughput envelopes.

increments.title: Army expansion
increments.objective: Activate additional specialists only when measured demand and qualification evidence justify them.

packages.title: Demand and coverage evidence
packages.completion_result: A customer, benchmark, or resilience need identifies a bounded specialist gap.

packages.title: Bounded specialist contract
packages.completion_result: Inputs, outputs, tools, risks, action tiers, evidence, and handoffs are explicit.

packages.title: Representative and safety scenarios
packages.completion_result: Representative, negative, and adversarial-safety scenarios exist with ground truth.

packages.title: Candidate implementation and evaluation
packages.completion_result: The candidate improves the approved scorecard over generalist and deterministic baselines.

packages.title: Qualified profile activation
packages.completion_result: The profile enters routing with versioned qualification, drift, incident, and maintenance ownership.

gate.title: Evidence-based Army growth
evidence_requirements: Each activated profile closes a measured outcome or resilience gap.
Each profile has bounded contracts and representative safety tests.
Each candidate improves mission outcomes enough to justify cost and coordination.
Each command can maintain qualification, drift response, and incident response.

increments.title: Defender validation and advanced modes
increments.objective: Connect offensive evidence to defensive outcomes and extend into restricted and high-risk domains only behind specific gates.

packages.title: Telemetry correlation
packages.completion_result: Offensive actions correlate with customer network, identity, cloud, application, endpoint, and data telemetry.

packages.title: Detection validation
packages.completion_result: Each material path is checked for alerts, investigation artifacts, and prevention events.

packages.title: Control validation
packages.completion_result: Specific identity, network, cloud, application, and data controls are tested against attack paths.

packages.title: Defender replay
packages.completion_result: The minimum safe path is replayed after control changes and compared with observed telemetry.

packages.title: Task-level multi-model routing
packages.completion_result: Candidate, model, tool, and budget are selected from measured task performance rather than global defaults.

packages.title: Two-deep critical roles
packages.completion_result: Command, safety, validation, and high-value specialties have independently qualified alternatives.

packages.title: Restricted deployment
packages.completion_result: Customer-hosted or disconnected workers use signed mission bundles, bounded tools, and exportable evidence.

packages.title: Advanced domain gates
packages.completion_result: OT, specialized protocols, model infrastructure, and other high-risk domains activate only under domain-specific safety policy.

gate.title: Defender outcome and advanced-mode readiness
evidence_requirements: Material offensive paths have correlated defensive telemetry and validated control outcomes.
Critical roles maintain qualified alternatives and bounded routing.
Restricted deployments preserve scope, custody, stop, cleanup, and evidence invariants.
Advanced domains pass separately approved domain-specific safety gates.

limitations: This roadmap authorizes planning and sequencing only.
No package state is complete without separately reviewed evidence.
Production target activity requires exact signed scope and the controls for its operating mode.
Defensive purpose does not authorize access to suspected attacker infrastructure outside signed scope.
The logical 403-profile catalog does not require 403 simultaneous model processes.
SQLite remains valid until measured concurrent service needs justify PostgreSQL.
